content: PIPELINE HARDENING — April 4-5, 2026. Claude Code applied 9 fixes to pipeline.py and stack_reader.py. Key changes: (1) UNKNOWN signal now defaults to PAUSE (safe middle ground) instead of WITNESS (most restrictive). Fuzzy fallback checks for signal keywords. (2) Error handling on classify(), act(), and raw() — graceful degradation, never silent failure. (3) stream_act() now mirrors Stack context injection from act(). (4) run() returns budget allocation in result dict. (5) stack_reader.py: 60-second heartbeat cache (eliminated 800 unnecessary health checks during benchmark runs). (6) Per-insight try/except in keyword scoring (one bad chronicle entry no longer kills context injection). Design principle: every fix follows the same rule — graceful degradation, never silent failure. If the compass fails, you get PAUSE. If generation fails, you get an error message. If the Stack is down, the pipeline continues without context.
